From: Erin Jacobs <erin.jacobs@cedarhealth.com>

Subject: Vendor security: initial questionnaires & SOC2 status

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this morning. CedarHealth is moving toward a formal vendor approval for any vendor that will touch PHI or customer PII. A couple of asks to kick off our procurement/security review: 

- Can you confirm current SOC 2 status (Type I vs Type II) and expected timeline for Type II if applicable?
- Are you able to sign a BAA / support HIPAA controls for private deployments?
- What is Redwood's GDPR data residency approach for EU customers?
- Please fill the attached vendor security questionnaire and return the filled spreadsheet.

We have a procurement window around mid-March and would like to understand whether Redwood can meet that timeline (SOC 2 Type II or an audit timeline, plus any compensating controls).

Attachment: CedarVendor_Q_2026.xlsx (vendor security questionnaire stub)

Best,
Erin Jacobs
Head of Vendor Governance
CedarHealth Systems
erin.jacobs@cedarhealth.com

--

Erin — thanks for sending this and for the call. Quick recap from our end and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Recap (what we covered)
- Deployment modes: Hosted API (SaaS), Dedicated GPU pools (reserved), and Private (VPC / on‑prem) — Cedar can choose model based on data classification.
- Data controls: Redwood supports Customer-managed keys (KMS), network isolation for Private, and optional token scrubbing.
- Compliance posture: SOC 2 Type II audit in progress (see notes below); HIPAA support via BAA available for Private and Dedicated configurations; GDPR support via regional deployments + DPA.

Immediate next steps (for procurement/security)
1) Redwood to return the attached questionnaire with initial answers (laura will lead).
2) Vivek to share a short SOC 2 progress summary and expected Type II completion date.
3) Schedule a follow-up 30‑min call next week to review any open technical controls (Vivek + our security engineer).
4) Procurement: please confirm the target decision date (you mentioned mid‑March).

Attached (initial drafts): Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Answers_draft.xlsx (answers keyed to your sheet)

Notes on SOC2: We are currently in the SOC 2 Type II audit window (audit started Nov 2025). Expected auditor finalization is currently projected for early March 2026; Vivek will confirm exact dates and what we can share in the meantime (bridge letter, interim reports, redacted evidence).

Deal reference: DL-2026-0842 (we'll add your procurement contact into HubSpot for easier tracking).

Happy to hop on a call — propose Tue 27 Jan 10:00 or Wed 28 Jan 14:00 EST.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Erin — thanks for the detail and for working with Karthik on timing. Short summary from security/infra and what we can provide immediately: 

What we can provide now
- Redacted SOC 2 progress summary (attached): outlines audit window, key control coverage, and expected completion. Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Progress_Summary.pdf
- Bridge letter: we can provide a bridge letter from our auditor noting that an audit is in progress and the scope it covers (will provide once auditor finalizes the template).
- BAA: Redwood will sign a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted API we have a BAA addendum — happy to share templates.
- GDPR: list of active EU regions and data processing addendum (DPA) details available on request.

Projected dates (current estimate)
- SOC 2 Type II audit period: Nov 01, 2025 — Feb 28, 2026 (fieldwork complete). Auditor is finalizing reports; expected report release target: Mar 12, 2026.
- ISO 27001: roadmap kickoff Q2 2026; multi‑quarter program, not a blocker for procurement but good to know for long‑term roadmap.
- FedRAMP: not on immediate roadmap — we support gov cloud patterns but FedRAMP would be a longer multi‑year program.

Next actions
1) Laura will finalize the questionnaire answers and we'll return the spreadsheet by EOD Tue 27 Jan.
2) I will upload a redacted SOC 2 progress summary to a secure drive link and share it here (see links).
3) If Cedar needs an evidence review call, propose Thu 29 Jan 11:00 EST (security engineer + infra).

- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-2026-0842
